description: Propose repairs for a chart and explicit artifact contract. By default this is proposal-only. If enabled, safe application fills missing component and configuration/data identity fields only; existing bindings are never overwritten. Mismatches require an explicit revision and claim reassessment. Source, evidence, review, approval, and time facts are never invented. Returned contracts omit evidence samples, report transfer losses, and are withheld above a 64 KiB UTF-8 cap.
